citations.claim: initial total energy before the step
first violating step: total energy jumped by ~137 exceeding allowed ~110

explanation: Largest dt (1/30) with G=5 and two 20-mass bodies starting 1.2 apart head-on at speed 7 plus close neighbours: bodies move ~0.23 per outer step and close approach to 0.65 within one step. Even with 6 adaptive substeps the leapfrog integration is too coarse for the strongly varying softened force, so kinetic jumps 980->2325 and potential -1993->-3202, net energy change ~137 exceeds tolerance ~110.
vision_note: At step 0 the two large upper bodies are separate with a small gap between them. At step 1 they have jumped together into overlap, while the three smaller lower bodies stay in a tight cluster.
